274917763.description:
OBSERVED FEATURES & INVENTORY
Rock Specimen Collection:
Boxed educational collection containing 15 individual rock specimens arranged in a compartmented tray.
Geoscience Industries Material:
Instruction sheet marked "Geoscience Industries Ft. Collins, CO."
Common Metamorphic Rocks Theme:
Included reference sheet titled "Common Metamorphic Rocks."
Educational Reference Materials:
Two printed study/reference sheets included covering metamorphic rock identification and changes during metamorphism.
Numbered Specimens:
Several rock samples retain numbered identification stickers.
Compartmented Display Tray:
White molded tray with individual specimen compartments.
Presentation Box:
Hinged cardboard presentation/storage box included.
Varied Rock Types:
Assortment of specimens displaying different colors, textures, grain structures, and metamorphic characteristics.
Instruction Sheet Content:
Reference material discusses foliated and non-foliated metamorphic rocks and associated classifications.
Complete As Pictured:
Fifteen specimen compartments appear populated with rock samples as shown in the photographs.
Box Dimensions:
Approximately 11" x 7" x 1.5".
Weight:
Approximately 1.395 lbs.
PERCEIVED FLAWS & CONDITION NOTES
Used Educational Set:
Set shows signs of previous handling, storage, and educational use.
Paper Wear:
Reference sheets exhibit creasing, curling, wrinkles, edge wear, and storage-related wear.
Box Wear:
Outer box shows handling wear, edge wear, minor dents, and light discoloration.
Tray Dust:
Minor dust, sediment, and loose rock particles visible within specimen compartments.
Label Wear:
Some specimen identification stickers show age, wear, or discoloration.
Specimen Identification Unverified:
Individual rock identifications have not been independently verified beyond the included educational materials.
Natural Imperfections:
Rock specimens contain natural fractures, uneven surfaces, inclusions, and variations inherent to geologic samples.
Completeness Not Guaranteed:
Set appears complete as photographed, but original factory contents cannot be independently confirmed.
Reference Material Wear:
Printed educational materials show age-related wear, folds, and handling marks.
Used AS-IS:
Item is offered in used condition as pictured. Only the rock specimens, tray, box, and printed materials shown in the photographs are included.

274886792.description: This natural rough amethyst crystal specimen measures approximately 5 inches wide and 4.5 inches tall. It features clusters of purple amethyst crystals embedded in a matrix of lighter and yellowish stone. The surfaces are unpolished and natural, displaying typical amethyst coloration from deep purple to lighter violet hues. The specimen contains visible inclusions and matrix material. It is unprocessed with no visible damage or artificial enhancements. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.

"Tested" indicates ONLY that the item has been powered on; no further testing or assessment of function has been done unless noted.

We are not able to provide individual item details on multi item lots. BULK LOTS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RETURNS OR REFUNDS. It is likely they will contain tangled and broken items, as well as incomplete sets/pairs.
Measurements for items are approximated. While we do our best to provide sizes for single item lots, we cannot do so for multi item lots.
